record.text:
Synthetic notes on retrieval evaluation.

We compare BM25, dense and hybrid retrieval on a ten-thousand-document synthetic corpus. Hybrid retrieval improved recall at ten by a modest margin.

Method: fixed query set, judged by two annotators.

Update: the margin shrank after a tokenizer fix.
